sentence: I meeting Lan at the cinema tomorrow evening.
ruleVi: Lịch hẹn tương lai: am / is / are + V-ing; I đi với am.

sentence: We are fly to Đà Nẵng next Saturday.
ruleVi: Việc đã sắp xếp trong tương lai dùng are + V-ing: are flying.

sentence: She is have dinner with her boss on Friday.
ruleVi: Sau is phải là V-ing: is having dinner on Friday.

sentence: My parents is coming to visit us next week.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ số nhiều đi với are + V-ing.

sentence: Where are you go on holiday next summer?
ruleVi: Hỏi kế hoạch đã sắp xếp: Where are you + V-ing + thời gian tương lai?

sentence: Minh not working tomorrow because it is a holiday.
ruleVi: Phủ định của hiện tại tiếp diễn: isn't + V-ing, không dùng doesn't.

sentence: Are you come to my birthday party on Sunday?
ruleVi: Câu hỏi về lịch hẹn: Are you + V-ing + thời gian tương lai?

sentence: I'm see the dentist at ten o'clock tomorrow.
ruleVi: Cuộc hẹn đã đặt: I'm + V-ing (I'm seeing the dentist).
Không được bỏ be: they are getting married next month.

sentence: I is starting a new job next Monday.
ruleVi: I đi với am: I am starting ... next Monday.
